notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ 20% Discount!! Summer Sale and Major Updates!🏴‍☠️
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Captains!
"Miss Neko: Pirates" is on sale for 20% in Steam Summer Sale! Now is the perfect time to grab the game!We’ve also prepared three new captivating characters for you to discover during your adventures.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44759877/5fec69783a3636e9872c0d009afa4225b5a0d133.jpg[/img]


To enhance the storyline experience, we’ve invited new artists to create detailed illustrations for all dialogue characters, replacing the previous chibi-style figures.

Additionally, we've made the following updates:
1.Fixed issues where some players lost data when loading saved games.
2.Fixed the problem of characters' dodge distance being too short.
3.Optimized level frame rates.

We hope these updates bring you a better gaming experience. Welcome, Captains, to update to the latest version!

Join Discord: https://discord.gg/7HBgrZCVPd

notes.title: April 12 Update Notes
notes.notes: Optimized the user experience of level-3

notes.title: Animated items in Point Shop are available!
Trading Card Items are available now!
Issue Fixes
notes.notes:
New Features
Switch weapons by pressing the "tab" key.
Unlock Astaria on the pirate ship by consecutively pressing "↑↓→←↑".

Issue Fixes
Fixed occasional issue where health potions wouldn't restore health in the game.

notes.title: Hot Fixes
notes.notes:
To help captains enjoy their time with their crew more, we are providing the following hidden features:
1.Pressing "G" "O" "D" consecutively while in-game will activate invincibility mode (deactivates after each loading screen, requiring reactivation upon returning to the game).
2.In the pirate ship scene, pressing "↑" "↓" "→" "←" "↑" consecutively will summon all crew members.
You will gain access to these features after the update.

Bug Fixes
1.Fixed the issue of walking in the air upon abyss at 2nd level .
2.Fixed the issue of passing through arena walls  at 3rd level.

notes.title: 🏴‍☠️ Miss Neko: Pirates Sets Sail Today! 🏴‍☠️
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Captains!
The wait is over – Miss Neko: Pirates is officially available today! Embark on an exhilarating voyage in this 2D bullet-hell shooter set amidst the high seas.
As the captain of the "Lucky Coin," you've faced betrayal and perilous encounters, but now is the time to reclaim what's rightfully yours! With your crew of adorable beastly girls and mysterious, seductive foes, what daring escapades await you in this maritime adventure?
Set sail now to embark on this thrilling journey! Captains, hoist the sails and dive into the action today! ⚓️🌊🔥
